quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A sudden, unexplained shift between two people who never got along draws out a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: An unexplained change between two people who always clashed naturally sparks curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The two colleagues who always disagreed about everything have suddenly started having lunch together every day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Knowing your material perfectly doesn't always settle a deeper, separate worry.
quests.explanation: Knowing the facts but not the reaction they'll get is a common, specific cause of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've memorized every fact about this pitch, but facts won't tell me how the room is going to react.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Feeling completely at peace in an ordinary morning moment points to a quiet, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling like you're exactly where you belong, in a simple morning moment, is a quiet happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I watched the sunrise with my coffee from the balcony. I thought: this is exactly where I'm supposed to be.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: One item deliberately left behind while everything else is packed away points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: One photograph left behind on purpose, while everything else is packed, is a quiet sign of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The photograph was still on the wall. Everything else in the room had been packed up, but he'd left that one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being told something is optional and then punished for it anyway tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Being punished for skipping something you were told was optional is a fair and common cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I was told the meeting was optional. I then received a written warning for not attending it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching your child handle something difficult, calmly and completely, brings a warm feeling of your own.
quests.explanation: Watching your child perform well under pressure is a classic, warm source of parental pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My son stood up in front of the whole class to explain his science project. He didn't miss a single word.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An old personal project suddenly becoming real points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: An old personal project finally being picked up for production is a genuine cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The script I wrote two years ago in a coffee shop has been optioned by a production company. They actually want to make it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Hours spent on something that could be read quickly on your own tends to bring one familiar reaction.
quests.explanation: Six hours spent on content that takes fifteen minutes to read is a plain, relatable cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The orientation session ran for six hours and covered material anyone could read in about fifteen minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Allowing yourself to imagine a good outcome, without being certain yet, points to a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Allowing yourself to imagine a good outcome, while still uncertain, is exactly what hope feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor said the treatment is working better than expected. We won't know for sure for a few more months, but for the first time, I can imagine it going well.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Holding others to a rule you then quietly break yourself points to an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Asking for an exception to a rule you enforced on others is a clear cause of guilt.
quests.textToSpeak: I told my team the deadline was firm and couldn't move. Then I quietly asked for two extra days for my own part.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A shared space that still feels incomplete after someone leaves points to a quiet, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A home that still feels like it's waiting for someone who's moved on is a gentle, common form of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: My roommate moved out last month to live with her boyfriend. The apartment still feels like it's waiting for her to come back.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Money given back and then quietly taken away again tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: A refund reversed overnight with no explanation is a fair and common cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The refund was processed but reversed the very next day, with no explanation given at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A goal reached far faster than expected, with support still pouring in, points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: A fundraising goal met in just two days, with support still coming in, is a clear cause of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We hit our fundraising goal in forty-eight hours. The phone hasn't stopped ringing since.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A high-stakes moment threatened by something completely out of your control points to a familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: A career-defining call threatened by a bad signal is a stressful, common cause of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: This is the most important call of my career, and the signal keeps dropping. I need five minutes and a quiet room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: High hopes for a specific outcome ending in an early, unexpected exit points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Confidently expecting a win and being eliminated early instead is a classic, relatable disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I really thought this would be the year we finally won the league. We were eliminated in the very first round.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeated effort that keeps producing the same result points to one familiar reaction.
quests.explanation: Repeating the same work three times with barely any real change is a clear cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: We've redesigned the homepage three times in two years, and it looks almost identical each time. What are we even doing?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small physical milestone after a long, slow recovery points to a particular, forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A small but real sign of progress after a long recovery is exactly what hope feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: It's been six months since the surgery. This week, for the first time, I walked the whole length of the garden without stopping.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone finally complete something they started six decades earlier brings a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching a family member complete a sixty-year-old goal is a deep source of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My grandmother finished her college degree this spring, sixty years after she first started it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Months of an unresolved problem with no action taken tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Four months of unresolved noise with no action from anyone responsible is a fair cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The noise from the renovation upstairs has been going on for four months, and building management has done absolutely nothing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being caught in an excuse that wasn't true points to an uncomfortable, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Being caught giving a false excuse to someone you let down is a clear cause of guilt.
quests.textToSpeak: I told my sister I was too busy to help her move. She then saw online that I'd gone to a concert that same weekend.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-underfunded project suddenly getting real backing points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: A long-struggling project finally getting real funding and support is a genuine cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The documentary was picked up by a major streaming platform. We start filming again, this time with a real budget.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Preparing for something good before it's fully confirmed points to a particular, forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Preparing for good news that isn't fully confirmed yet is a warm, natural form of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The adoption agency said there's a strong match and we should hear more within the month. I've already started painting the spare room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Months of preparation ending short of the goal, for reasons outside your control, points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Months of training ending short of the finish line, through no fault of your own, is a real disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I trained for this marathon for eight months. I had to stop at mile eighteen because of my knee.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Hesitating for a long time before a single, significant action points to a familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: Hesitating for twenty minutes before sending one significant message is a clear sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My hand is literally on the send button. This email changes everything. I've been sitting here for twenty minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A rare stretch of true rest, without any leftover pressure, points to a light, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: A rare week of complete rest, without any guilt attached, is a simple and full happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: For the first time in three years, I had a full week with no deadlines, no meetings, and no guilt about enjoying it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Staying silent while someone else takes the blame for your mistake points to an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Letting someone else take the blame for your own mistake is a direct and common cause of guilt.
quests.textToSpeak: My coworker got blamed for a mistake in the report. I know it was actually mine, and I still haven't said anything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Careful advance planning met with total denial of any record tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Careful planning erased with no apology or explanation is a fair, relatable cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I made the reservation two months in advance. I arrive and there's no record of it anywhere. No apology, no explanation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Comparing a hard-won result to where you started months ago brings a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Comparing real progress to where you started is a genuine, personal source of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: I finally ran the whole 5K without stopping to walk. Six months ago I couldn't run for two minutes straight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Checking for news well before it's actually expected points to a particular, forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Checking early for news you're not expecting yet is a small, natural sign of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The interview panel said they'd let candidates know by Friday. It's only Wednesday, but I keep checking my email anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Having a solid answer ready for every possible challenge points to a settled mindset.
quests.explanation: Having evidence-based answers ready for any objection is a clear expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've prepared for every possible objection. Whatever comes up, I have an answer grounded in real evidence.
